description: Real response from Polymarket CLOB API /price endpoint. Recorded back-to-back with orderbook_response from same token at same time. Query side=SELL to get ask price (what user pays to BUY). Returns: 0.155. Note: Polymarket 'side' is book side, not user action - inverted in our adapter. Price algorithm may use depth/recent trades, not just top of book.
